items.title: Establish the Linux unofficial isolated-home contract
acceptance: ADR 0007 authorizes version-scoped black-box isolation while production capabilities remain gated.

verification.command: synthetic isolation tests and local gates
verification.outcome: passing; distinct cleared environments and unsafe-root refusal

items.title: Implement the TTY-preserving isolated launcher
acceptance: Interactive children inherit standard streams, direct argv, validated TERM, and a cleared environment.
Two empty homes safely probe installed agy 1.1.2 with --version only.

verification.command: python3 scripts/check.py; fake launcher tests; two installed-client --version probes
verification.outcome: passing; 37 tests, exact child status/argv, empty disposable homes, and local policy gates

items.title: Implement managed profile directories and fake add/exec contracts
acceptance: Managed profile directories derive only from UUIDs and are owner-only.
Relative roots, links, non-directories, unsafe permissions, and Linux ownership fail closed.
Fake add reserves pending metadata before delegated login and commits ready only after success.
Fake exec refuses non-ready profiles and preserves literal argv and exact child status.
No CLI command, real login, credential access, or production capability is enabled.
